Core package of the VecTiles.NET vector tile mapping stack. Mapsforge support for the VecTiles.NET vector tile mapping stack. It bundles VecTiles.Styles.Mapsforge (Mapsforge render theme parser) and VecTiles.Converters.Mapsforge which converts raw Mapsforge vector tiles to VectorTile objects.

Mapsui integration for the VecTiles.NET vector tile mapping stack. Provides VecTiles.Controls.Mapsui, which connects the VecTiles vector tile data sources, styles and the Skia based renderer to Mapsui, e.g. to display styled vector tile maps inside a Mapsui map control.

OpenMapTiles support for the VecTiles.NET vector tile mapping stack. It bundles VecTiles.Styles.OpenMapTiles (styles in the Mapbox style format) and VecTiles.Converters.OpenMapTiles convert Mapbox/OpenMapTiles vector tiles (MVT, PBF optionally zipped) to VectorTile objects.

Skia based renderer for the VecTiles.NET vector tile mapping stack. Provides VecTiles.Renderers.Skia, which renders styled vector tiles (fill, line and symbol layers, including text) to a bitmap using SkiaSharp and HarfBuzz shaped text.
